title: Fox finds Marco Chereze's sister Marta

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker who investigates UFOs, tells of searching in Varginha, a town in Brazil, for the family of a man named Marco Chereze, who figures in a local story about a captured creature. Fox says that after hours of knocking on doors, one finally opened and there stood Marco's sister, Marta. For Fox, finding her meant reaching someone close to the heart of the case.
